frequency_question: How often do unified legislative majorities successfully push through and finalize their partisan maps without internal breakdown within the designated cycle window?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a single political party held legislative majorities and executive/judicial alignment sufficient to enact a map; excludes bipartisan consensus commissions.
coverage_note: 8 named key partisan redistricting pushes under unified control; all successfully executed by the principals.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative delays that did not alter final map implementation.
validity_reason: Based on current state legislative polarization dynamics which remain stable through the next general election cycle.
